description_en: Queries the quota details of the plan associated with a specific instance or site by quota name
description_zh: 根据配额名称查询当前实例或者站点对应的套餐的配额详情
name: ListInstanceQuotas

parameters.help_en: The plan instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the ID. You must specify at least one of this parameter and SiteId
parameters.help_zh: 套餐实例ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口获取。与参数 SiteId 至少传其一
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the ID. You must specify at least one of this parameter and InstanceId
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口获取。与参数 InstanceId 至少传其一
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.name: quota_names

Quotas.description_en: The list of plan instance quotas

QuotaValueType.description_en:
The threshold type of the quota. Valid values:

value: enumeration type. The enumeration range of quota values.
bool: Boolean type. Indicates whether the quota is available.
num: numeric type. The maximum usage of the quota.
range: range type. The value range of the quota.
custom: custom type. Other types that do not fall into the preceding four threshold types
QuotaValueType.description_zh:
配额的阈值类型。取值：

value：枚举类型。配额的取值枚举范围。
bool：布尔类型。配额是否可用。
num：数值类型。配额使用数量上限。
range：范围类型。配额的取值大小范围。
custom：自定义类型。除以上四种配额阈值类型的其他类型

Status.description_en:
The plan instance status. Valid values:

online: The instance is in normal service.
offline: The instance has expired but has not exceeded the grace period and is unavailable.
disable: The instance has been released
Status.description_zh:
套餐实例状态。支持：

online：正常服务状态。
offline：到期但未超期，处于不可用的状态。
disable：已释放状态
